subject.summary: Recycling and reclamation workers sort paper, plastic, metal, glass, and other recyclables by material, remove items unsuitable for the process, and bale, move, weigh, and record the destination per on-site procedures. Equipment, vehicles, and suspected hazardous materials must be handled by trained, authorized personnel; when something is abnormal, stop work first, isolate, and escalate.
